caption: The drawing features a rectangular, brownish-tan surface as the base, with embossed, capitalized text arranged in three centered lines. The text reads: "C. CROLIUS", "MANHATTAN, WELLS", and "NEW-YORK". The letters are shaded to appear raised and have a dark bluish tone in their shadows. Above and below the text, there are stylized floral or foliate decorations rendered in a dark blue color, with three-pronged forms at the top and bottom, and curving shapes extending horizontally on each side under the text. The composition is framed by a soft edge where the brown color fades into the lighter surrounding paper, and there is a faint blue shadow or stain partially encircling the design on the left and right. Near the lower left corner, outside the central composition, is a faint, handwritten signature.
title: Jug
